answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making voting weight sublinear in locked collateral: every identity needs an attested key, and its weight is the square root of its stake. Splitting one treasury across a dune of fake accounts earns less power than keeping it in one, since each clone still posts its own bond. To double its vote an attacker must lock four times the capital, and forged keys are slashed. That superlinear price is the ledge this system stands on, and the nectar of influence stays with honest agents.
